fields.field: User-selected 16MB flash / 8MB PSRAM. 44-pin order from saved supplier pinout. Socket row spacing 22.86mm PROVISIONAL. Inward antenna extension 10mm; module PCB underside +8.5mm above carrier top is an assumed socket stack. Internal RGB pin is disputed (47 pinout / 48 schematic). Use separate RGB LED on GPIO38, socket pad32; no engine pulses. Verify actual board fit and RF performance before fabrication/use. A5 adds GPIO3 idle service through J21 and permanent R154 bias; actual eFuse/JTAG routing and loaded output behavior remain unverified.

property.name: DesignNote
property.value: User-selected 16MB flash / 8MB PSRAM. 44-pin order from saved supplier pinout. Socket row spacing 22.86mm PROVISIONAL.
